label: FC311A-20 gigabit WDM media converter (single fibre, 20 km)
description: Gigabit WDM converter with one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 port and a single-fibre SC port (TX 1310 nm / RX 1550 nm) that reaches 20 km on one single-mode strand. It occupies one core only because the A side transmits on 1310 and receives on 1550, so it must pair with the B-side unit (FC311B-20).
